display.purpose: Page titles and the hub title; tight tracking, heavy weight.

shadows.name: rim
shadows.purpose: The bright edge that makes glass read as glass.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Every transition: menus, dialogs, tab lens, hover lifts.

motion.name: field-drift
motion.purpose: The three charge-lights behind the glass.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action on a screen: flat yellow pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.35); border-radius: 999px; background: #fcd95c; color: #1f1f22; font: 650 14px system-ui;  text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(110,78,0,.35); cursor: pointer; transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f1f22; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Button
components.description: Secondary actions: a flat outlined pill.
components.css: .ds-btn-glass { min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78); border-radius: 999px; background: #fffdf6; color: #1f1f22; font: 650 14px system-ui; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-glass:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.6); } .ds-btn-glass:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1f1f22; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Glass Input
components.description: An inset well cut into the glass.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 240px; min-height: 46px; padding: 12px 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.40); color: #1f1f22; font: 14px system-ui; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(110,78,0,.14), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: rgba(31,31,34,.66); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 5px rgba(110,78,0,.14), 0 0 0 3px rgba(31,31,34,.35); }

components.name: Glass Panel
components.description: The surface for tables, detail views and boards.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 28px; border-radius: 26px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78); background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.52), rgba(255,255,255,.30) 62%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95), inset 0 -1px 0 rgba(110,78,0,.10), 0 28px 60px -26px rgba(110,78,0,.34); backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(1.8); color: #1f1f22; font: 14px system-ui; } .ds-panel p { margin: 6px 0 0; opacity: .74; }

components.name: Rail Bead
components.description: A section on the left rail; the active one glows green.
components.css: .ds-bead { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; color: rgba(31,31,34,.74); } .ds-bead:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.52); transform: scale(1.1); } .ds-bead-on { color: #1f1f22; background: #fcd95c;  }

components.name: Section Tabs
components.description: A glass capsule with a green lens under the active tab.
components.css: .ds-tabs { position: relative; display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 4px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78); background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,.52), rgba(255,255,255,.30)); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95); font: 600 13px system-ui; } .ds-tabs a { position: relative; z-index: 1; padding: 9px 16px; color: #1f1f22; } .ds-tabs a.on { color: #1f1f22; } .ds-lens { position: absolute; top: 4px; bottom: 4px; left: 70px; width: 74px; border-radius: 99px; background: #fcd95c;  }

components.name: Status Capsule
components.description: A glass pill with a lit dot for state.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 4px 12px 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78); background: rgba(255,255,255,.40); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.95); font: 700 12px system-ui; color: #2e6b1f; } .ds-status::before { content: ''; width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2fbf71; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,191,113,.3), 0 0 10px #2fbf71; }

narrative.overview:
Everything is one material: a pane of glass lit from behind by a warm field. Panels, the rail, the section tabs, menus and dialogs are all the same glass, so the interface reads as a single object rather than a stack of cards. The field behind it is alive: three soft lights drift slowly, the way a cell takes charge. Light also lives on the glass itself: a bright rim on the top edge, a sheen across the face.

The palette is the Beverly Call one: pearl and cream grounds, a single yellow for every action, and dark ink for text.
keyCharacteristics: One accent, Beverly yellow, drawn as a flat fill; everything else is cream, pearl, glass and ink.
Light is frosted white glass over cream; dark is smoked glass over near-black.
Pills for every control; large radii for every surface.
Dark ink on yellow, never white.
Unknown data shows a dash, never a made-up number.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Yellow is the only accent. Green and red appear only as state dots and messages.

rules.name: The Dark Ink On Yellow Rule
rules.body: Text on yellow is #1f1f22. White on yellow fails contrast.

rules.name: The Unknown Is A Dash Rule
rules.body: A reading the platform did not send is shown as a dash, never as zero.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number in a table or readout uses tabular figures so columns stay aligned.

rules.name: The Rim Rule
rules.body: Every glass edge carries a bright 1px top highlight. Without it the surface is just a blurred box.

rules.name: The Palette Rule
rules.body: A palette changes the accent family, the field and the ink tint, and nothing else. Layout, shape, type and glass are identical in all three.

dos: Do put every surface on the one glass material, with the rim and the sheen.
Do keep text on at least 4.5:1 contrast over the fill, and raise the fill where a surface floats over busy content.
Do put dark ink on yellow.
Do show a dash for unknown data.
Do keep motion to the tab lens and the field's slow drift, both off under reduced motion.
donts: Don't add a second accent colour.
Don't nest glass inside glass; use a line or an inset well instead.
Don't use overshoot or bounce easing; use exponential ease-out.
Don't put a label or kicker above a heading.
Don't use hard corners, hard offset shadows, or gradient text.
